scope: One guarded Lake process at a time. Before each single-module build, --no-build +Module:deps must prove its prerequisite facets current under identical frozen inputs/options. The following +Module:olean should therefore compile only that module. Any failed dependency check stops before the build. A 0.5-second process scan kills multiple or unexpected compiler processes as a backstop; it does not claim to prevent every sub-0.5-second process. All existing physical-memory limits and first-failure stop rules apply.
